notes: Explore idea: differential-test env-example-drift-check's parseExampleFile against four real .env loaders (Node 22.23.5 util.parseEnv, npm dotenv 16.4.7 and 17.2.3, python-dotenv 1.0.1), scoring each key against the 3-of-4 loader majority (2-2 splits unscored). Dev seeds 1-2000; held-out seeds 50001-55000 fixed in advance and run once: agreement 76.44% -> 99.75% (phantom 1,375 -> 4, missed 3,246 -> 44). Fixes: multi-line quoted values (", ', backtick) swallow inner NAME= lines; keys [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+; quoted reference forms take the same names; lone \r ends a line; escaped quotes don't close. Side finding: Node util.parseEnv('A= \nB=1\n') returns {A:'B=1'} (drops B), unlike the other three. Local checks: run_venture_tests env-example-drift-check ok 82 tests; check_posts ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes pages.yml 6/6 run steps passed, ventures-tests detached and awaited before merge. Next: the same oracle for dotenv-exposure-check's parseEnvLines. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 10/11 workflows passed; distribution-versions-ci failed on stale versions.json, fixed in the final commit; agent-cross-review and deploy jobs not run locally.
